annotation_method: Assistant-authored after local corpus inspection; exact source excerpts checked programmatically; no independent human review.
evaluation_scope: Answers grounded in the supplied local FIIT snapshot; no live website verification.
exclusions: Review chunks, OCR warnings and supporting analytics are excluded from positive evidence.
Original 30-question evaluation and original corpus files are unchanged.
split_policy: 30 dev / 90 test, selected for topic coverage (dev: 25 answerable, 3 clarification, 2 unavailable). Connected evidence chunks and their exact HTML aliases stay in one split. Distinct chunks from the same document may occur in both; not a document-disjoint split or random sample.
retrieval_labels: Known sufficient source sets, not exhaustive relevance judgments. Match any alternative per support set. Non-answerable questions have no retrieval qrels.
limitations: Exact quote validation proves provenance, not semantic correctness.
A static snapshot cannot establish current validity or live/personal data.
Coverage is selected student-facing topics, not every document.
No embedding index is present in this workspace, so model retrieval/answer quality has not been measured.
